object_description: compact two-storey volume with internal courtyards
design_condition: The compact volume is placed in the eastern part of the plot, preserving open space around the existing clinic, with northern access and courtyards concealed within partially disintegrated facades.

positive.statement: The areas are clearly separated, sensibly arranged, and reachable via short routes.
The patient rooms on the upper floor offer a high quality of living.
The light-flooded inner courtyard creates a high interior quality through different views.
The courtyards meet different uses and needs.
The clinker facades are simple, clearly formulated, and carefully detailed.
The building grid would allow easy conversion into an office building, supporting sustainability.

negative.statement: The lighting in the patient rooms through the relatively narrow, slightly angled windows would have to be checked again inside.
The intensive walking area located directly above the main entrance is problematic.
The exclusive use of clinker contrasts with the existing buildings.
The materialization makes the building seem strange in the ensemble.
The volumetrics and detailing of the facade create a relatively strong prison character.
